description: This file is a shell script implementing an IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel backend for OpenWrt, defining functions to set up, update, and teardown a 6in4 tunnel, along with configuration method definitions and network update routines.

methods.name: test_6in4_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if the provided IPv4 address falls within private or reserved ranges as per RFC 1918 and RFC 6598.

methods.name: proto_6in4_update
methods.description: Runs a command with a timeout, attempting to execute URL update commands reliably within a specified timeout.

methods.name: proto_6in4_add_prefix
methods.description: Adds an IPv6 prefix to the configuration.

methods.name: proto_6in4_setup
methods.description: Sets up the IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel with provided configuration parameters, including IP addresses, prefixes, tunnel links, and optional updates via Tunnelbroker.

methods.name: proto_6in4_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down the tunnel, currently empty.

methods.name: proto_6in4_init_config
methods.description: Initializes configuration options for the tunnel protocol.
